cbbranitz.name: Branitz Park
cbbranitz.slogan: A prince painted this landscape with lakes, hills and trees.
cbbranitz.line: Prince Pückler's lake pyramid was raised around 1856; he was buried in it in 1871, about 13 metres high.

cbkahnluebbenau.name: Spreewald Punt Ride
cbkahnluebbenau.slogan: Glide past farmhouses where the street is a stream.
cbkahnluebbenau.line: About 1,300 km of canals thread the Spreewald, a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 1991.

cbf60.name: F60 Conveyor Bridge
cbf60.slogan: Lying down, it still out-sizes the Eiffel Tower.
cbf60.line: The F60 is 502 metres long and worked for just 15 months, March 1991 to June 1992, before being saved from scrapping.

cbtropical.name: Tropical Islands
cbtropical.slogan: Palm trees and a rainforest under a hangar roof.
cbtropical.line: The hall was built as an airship hangar; it is 360 m long and 107 m high, but the airship was never built.

cbstaatstheater.name: Staatstheater Cottbus
cbstaatstheater.slogan: Jugendstil curves that make a night out feel grand.
cbstaatstheater.line: Berlin architect Bernhard Sehring, who also built the Theater des Westens, designed this Jugendstil theatre, opened in 1908.
